jobs.notes: Only forward-dated early-careers window I could verify from an official firm source — Allens states applications for the May 2027 Dive In program open in March 2027 (month only, no exact date published), and it is an insight program for pre-penultimate students (2nd/3rd-year LLB or 1st-year JD) rather than a clerkship or graduate program; Allens' own page confirms its 2026/27 clerkship applications are closed and gives no 2027/28 open date.
